name: Saimin Gakuen 3-nensei
source:
The protagonist is a student of a third rate university with an awkward personality and sullen looks. His interests are deviant as well, but as an adult he has no shame about this. He acts like a stalker, and sneakily digs through the trash in the middle of the night. Naturally he's avoided by everyone around him.

At one point, he picked something like a toy gun out of the trash. Wondering if it might not have some monetary value he began to fiddle with it, and unexpectedly it became clear it was a device for inducing hypnosis.

Then, knowing it would normally be entirely impossible, using that device he became a student teacher in an all-girls school. Through this, the protagonist set about satisfying his own desires to his heart's content.

[Translated from [url=http://www.fudegaki.jp/sannen/story.html]Fuedgaki Soft's product page[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名三流大学的学生，性格尴尬，面色阴沉。他的兴趣也有偏差，但作为一个成年人，他对此并不感到羞耻。他像跟踪狂一样，在半夜偷偷地翻垃圾。自然而然地，周围的人都对他避而远之。

有一次，他从垃圾堆里捡起了一把类似玩具枪的东西。他想知道它是否具有一定的货币价值，他开始摆弄它，出乎意料的是，它显然是一种诱导催眠的装置。

然后，他知道这在通常情况下是完全不可能的，于是他使用该设备成为了一所女子学校的实习老师。由此，主人公开始尽情地满足自己的欲望。

[译自[url=http://www.fudegaki.jp/sannen/story.html]Fuedgaki Soft的产品页面[/url]]
